features.featureTitle: Add a Razorpay setup modal component (similar to the existing StripeSetupModal) that allows the admin/owner to enter their Razorpay Key ID and Key Secret. Wire it into the Settings page with a dedicated 'Razorpay Setup' button visible only to authenticated users. Add corresponding useRazorpayConfig and useSetRazorpayConfiguration hooks mirroring the existing useStripeConfig pattern.

Update the Upgrade page (frontend/src/pages/Upgrade.tsx) to display a Razorpay payment option for INR (₹) alongside the existing Stripe option. When the user selects Razorpay checkout, call the backend to create a Razorpay order, load the Razorpay JS SDK (https://checkout.razorpay.com/v1/checkout.js) dynamically, open the Razorpay checkout modal, and on successful payment call the backend verifyRazorpayPayment method. On verified success, redirect to the existing PaymentSuccess page. On failure, redirect to PaymentFailure page.

Add an AdSense configuration section to the Settings page where the authenticated user can enter and save their Google AdSense Publisher ID (ca-pub-XXXXXXXX). Add a useAdSenseConfig hook to read and update the publisher ID. Dynamically inject the Google AdSense script tag (<script async src='https://pagead2.googlesyndication.com/pagead/js/adsbygoogle.js?client=ca-pub-XXXX'>) into the page head when a publisher ID is configured. Add AdSense ad unit placeholders (ins.adsbygoogle) in appropriate locations: below the video player in VideoPlayer.tsx and in the sidebar area in Layout.tsx.
